faq.title: Questions about paying
faq.exploreQ: Is it really free to explore?
faq.exploreA: Yes. Browsing the catalogue, comparing programmes, chatting with Sarthi and applying all cost nothing. You only pay when you enrol in a course.
faq.feeQ: What does a course fee cover?
faq.feeA: The fee shown on each course covers all of it — video lessons, live classes, study material, tests and assignments, the AI tutor, and a verifiable certificate on completion.
faq.emiA: Eligible programmes offer no-cost EMI over 3, 6, 9 or 12 months through our partner lenders. You pay only the first instalment to enrol. Try the calculator above, and see <link>Scholarships & EMI</link> for details.
faq.scholarshipA: Merit, need-based and category scholarships can reduce tuition by up to 35%. Check what you qualify for on the <link>Scholarships</link> page.
faq.recognitionQ: Are the certificates and degrees recognised?
faq.recognitionA: Our degree programmes are UGC-entitled, and every certificate we issue is verifiable online at <link>Verify Certificate</link>.

pricing.noFees: No hidden fees. Cancel an unpaid application any time.

about.title: Education shouldn't end because <accent>life got in the way</accent>
about.sub: Millions of Indians leave formal education for reasons that have nothing to do with ability — money, family, illness, a job that couldn't wait. Shiksha Sarthi exists to help them pick it back up, from Class 10 all the way to postgraduate study.

guidance.title: Guidance before selling
guidance.body: We start by understanding where you stopped and why — not by pushing whichever programme pays us most.

recognised.title: Only recognised degrees
recognised.body: Every programme listed is UGC-entitled, UGC-DEB approved or AICTE approved. If it isn't recognised, it isn't here.

secondChances.title: Built for second chances
secondChances.body: Dropouts, career switchers, working parents. The people mainstream admissions quietly leave behind.

govtJobs.q: Are these degrees valid for government jobs?
govtJobs.a: Yes. UGC-entitled online and UGC-DEB approved distance degrees hold the same status as on-campus degrees for employment and higher study, per UGC regulations.

dropout.q: I dropped out years ago. Can I still continue?
dropout.a: In most cases yes. Open universities accept learners without an unbroken academic record, and several programmes have no upper age limit. Tell the counsellor your last completed level and we will map the options.

delivery.a: Online programmes combine live sessions with recorded lectures, downloadable notes and assignments — all available in your dashboard. Distance programmes are self-paced with study material and term-end exams.

charge.q: What does Shiksha Sarthi charge me?
charge.a: Nothing for counselling or admission support. You pay the university's fee directly; we earn a referral fee from partner institutions.

contact.title: We're here to <accent>help you decide</accent>
contact.sub: Admissions questions, fee structures, document requirements — ask away.
contact.safetyNote: Counselling calls are free and there's no obligation to enrol. We never ask for payment over the phone — always pay the university through the official admission flow.
